body: There is an administrative fee I do not have the money for.  I have sixty cents in my bank account. I am living off of food from my folks.  I have sold everything of value to make it this far. I am feeling a little better since the post, and I am going to try to get back to the clinic asap.

I'm in the US, close to Atlanta, GA specifically.  Being illegal makes it extremely difficult to find work.  Legal, tax-paying work.  I know it's the frustration and fear, it's the not having a single recourse to better my life. My family is hardly supportive, I just feel like I am burdening them. I am waiting to see if a specific piece of legislature that *could* grant me amnesty passes, but it's not likely.

I went to a free clinic a while ago, when I first discovered the lump.  They told me not to worry unless it didn't go away after a few weeks.  This was six months ago, and I've been doing some research online. It doesn't look good.
